status: Built and committed locally as 288d8e8 on branch claude/zen-hopper-1iqtdn. It was not pushed and was not in a pull request when recorded. Test files only: no application code changed and no defect was found. There is no visual or live acceptance.

commit.message: test: acceptance tests for the workspace card, place options and sample-mode lines (CQ-52, CQ-70, CQ-06)

assertions: Exactly one primary action per card: 'New request in <name>' to /account/drafts/<id>, or the request form when saved drafts are off.
All other actions sit inside a closed 'More for <name>' menu.

The owner More menu holds the six original extras in order with exact hrefs: Continue a saved draft, Send a private request, Edit company profile, Plan delegations, Paid-service requests, Plan and billing.
A member's menu has 'View company profile' instead of 'Edit company profile' and no 'Plan delegations'.
With only requests on, the primary action is /account/request/<id> and there is no More menu. With requests and billing on, More holds only 'Plan and billing'.
CQ-52.codeFactNotDefect: With drafts on but requests off there is no More menu, and 'Continue a saved draft' is reachable only through the primary action, which points to the same drafts page.

assertions: No place question until a service is chosen.

Options are 'Choose a place' plus the chosen catalogue entry's regions in order (source customer_private.service_catalogue_version.regions text[]; 1 to 12 regions are required by packages/delivery/src/customer-service-staff.ts; the server denial 'That service is not offered in this region' is already covered by tests/integration/customer-service-requests.test.ts:636).
Switching service replaces the options and resets the place.
The place is a closed required select (no free text); an empty place keeps Send disabled.
The POST carries the service key and a place from that service's list.
CQ-70.fixtures: Explicit protocol fixtures, not the real catalogue or production data.

assertions: realUseEnabled() is DATA_ENVIRONMENT=real, CORRIDRA_REAL_USE_ENABLED=true and not production-locked.

Real use off: the customer frame prints 'Preview workspace: use made-up names and details here.' Real use on: 'Your work stays private to the people given access.' and no made-up line. Real use requested on a locked production deployment still prints the sample line.

The /plan intake notice in sample mode shows 'Test mode', the invented-details and @example.invalid lines, 'Sample requests stay private to this account.', 'Email delivery is not enabled.' and a data-madeup-panel marker; in real mode none of them.
CQ-06.notTouched: apps/web/lib/owner-switches.ts: its copy fix needs the owner's wording approval.

required removed from the select: test 3 fails.

Intake notice always real: tests 4 and 6 fail. Always sample: tests 5 and 6 fail.

CQ-06 is limited to the customer frame note and the /plan intake notice, not every 'sample' word.
